findings.expected: Missing activity.json returns 404/422 and LedgerErrorView ("Can't read …") with Retry
findings.actual: Under `vite`/`vite preview`, missing /activity.json is SPA-fallbacked as HTML 200; UI shows "Unexpected token '<', \"<!doctype \"... is not valid JSON" + Retry
findings.repro: rm web/public/activity.json; curl -i http://127.0.0.1:5173/activity.json; reload UI
findings.environment: Linux, Vite 5.4.21, Playwright chromium, PR head ceebb76
findings.notes: Pre-existing Vite SPA fallback behavior; MM-012 did not introduce LedgerLoadError. Empty + malformed paths are OK.
